no_images.reason: The publication has no selected image.
no_images.fix: Select at least one image and schedule the publication again.

too_many_images.reason: There are more images than {{network}} accepts.
too_many_images.fix: Remove the extra images (the maximum is 20) and schedule the publication again.

media_needs_crop.reason: An image has a ratio that {{network}} does not accept.
media_needs_crop.fix: Crop the image for {{network}} in “Configure publication” and schedule it again.

media_format.reason: The format, weight or size of an image is not valid for {{network}}.
media_format.fix: Adjust the images in “Configure publication” to generate a valid copy and schedule it again.

media_rejected.fix: Try another image or adjust it again and schedule the publication again.

caption_too_long.reason: The text is over Instagram's character limit.
caption_too_long.fix: Shorten the publication text and schedule it again.

commentary_too_long.reason: The text is over the {{network}} character limit (LinkedIn: 3,000; Facebook: 63,206).
commentary_too_long.fix: Shorten the publication text and schedule it again.

too_many_hashtags.reason: The text has more than 30 hashtags, Instagram's maximum.
too_many_hashtags.fix: Remove some hashtags and schedule the publication again.

too_many_mentions.reason: The text has more than 20 mentions, Instagram's maximum.
too_many_mentions.fix: Remove some mentions and schedule the publication again.

rate_limited.reason: {{network}} has temporarily limited the account's publishing.
rate_limited.fix: You do not need to do anything: it will be retried automatically.

processing.fix: You do not need to do anything: it will be retried automatically in a few minutes.

container_expired.reason: The preparation of the post on Instagram expired.
container_expired.fix: You do not need to do anything: it will be prepared again automatically.

token_invalid.reason: {{network}} rejected the access: the connection has expired or is no longer valid.
token_invalid.fix: Reconnect {{network}} in Settings and press Retry.

permission_missing.reason: A permission needed to publish on {{network}} is missing.
permission_missing.fix: Reconnect {{network}} in Settings accepting all permissions and press Retry.

account_restricted.reason: The {{network}} account cannot publish right now (restriction or pending verification).
account_restricted.fix: Check the account status on {{network}} and press Retry once it is solved.

provider_unavailable.reason: {{network}} did not answer or had a temporary failure.
provider_unavailable.fix: It will be retried automatically; if the attempts run out, press Retry.

invalid_request.fix: Check the text and images and schedule it again, or press Retry if you think it was a one-off failure.

not_connected.reason: There is no active connection with {{network}}.
not_connected.fix: Connect {{network}} in Settings and press Retry.

connection_expired.reason: The connection with {{network}} has expired or was revoked.
connection_expired.fix: Reconnect {{network}} in Settings and press Retry.

page_not_authorized.reason: The selected account or page is no longer authorised on {{network}}.
page_not_authorized.fix: Reconnect {{network}} in Settings, select the account again and press Retry.

outcome_unknown.reason: We do not know whether the post was published on {{network}}.
outcome_unknown.fix: Check on {{network}} whether the post already exists before retrying, so it is not published twice.

lease_expired.fix: You do not need to do anything: it will be retried automatically.

internal_error.reason: An internal error occurred while publishing.
internal_error.fix: Press Retry; if it happens again, contact support.

provider_rejected.reason: {{network}} rejected the publication without giving a reason.
provider_rejected.fix: Check the content and press Retry.

provider_response_invalid.reason: {{network}} sent an answer we could not interpret.
provider_response_invalid.fix: Press Retry; if it happens again, contact support.

api_version_unsupported.reason: The {{network}} API version is no longer supported.
api_version_unsupported.fix: This is on our side: contact support.

invalid_account.reason: The account selected on {{network}} is not valid.
invalid_account.fix: Schedule the publication again choosing the account again.

media_url_invalid.reason: An image is not in a storage location valid for publishing.
media_url_invalid.fix: Select or upload the image again and schedule the publication again.

media_too_large.reason: An image is too heavy for {{network}} (up to 30 MB on LinkedIn and 10 MB on Facebook).
media_too_large.fix: Use a lighter image and schedule the publication again.

media_unreadable.reason: One of the images could not be read.
media_unreadable.fix: Replace the image with another one and schedule the publication again.

unknown.reason: The post could not be published on {{network}}.
unknown.fix: Press Retry; if it happens again, contact support.
